classifyThinkingError(thinkingContent) {\\n  const categories = CONFIG.thinking_error_config?.categories || {};\\n  \\n  // 正常反思\\n  for (const pattern of categories.NORMAL_REFLECTION?.patterns || []) zero_hidden_mode: CONFIG.zero_hidden_record_config?.zero_hidden_mode || true,\\n      no_filter: CONFIG.zero_hidden_record_config?.no_filter || true,\\n      no_hide: CONFIG.zero_hidden_record_config?.no_hide || true,\\n      no_simplify: CONFIG.zero_hidden_record_config?.no_simplify || true,\\n      no_delay: CONFIG.zero_hidden_record_config?.no_delay || true\\n    },\\n    ...recordData\\n  };\\n  \\n  // 寫入記錄文件\\n  const recordFile = '/home/admin/.openclaw/logs/think-config-violation-records.jsonl';\\n  fs.appendFileSync(recordFile, JSON.stringify(record) + classifyThinkingError(thinkingContent) {\\n  const categories = CONFIG.thinking_error_config?.categories || {};\\n  \\n  // 正常反思\\n  for (const pattern of categories.NORMAL_REFLECTION?.patterns || []) {\\n    const regex = new RegExp(pattern, 'i');\\n    if (regex.test(thinkingContent)) {\\n      return {\\n        category: 'NORMAL_REFLECTION',\\n        action: 'exclude',\\n        record: false,\\n        reason: '正常思考過程'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 不確定表達\\n  for (const pattern of categories.UNCERTAINTY?.patterns || []) {\\n    const regex = new RegExp(pattern, 'i');\\n    if (regex.test(thinkingContent)) {\\n      return {\\n        category: 'UNCERTAINTY',\\n        action: 'exclude',\\n        record: false,\\n        reason: '不確定表達'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 真實錯誤\\n  for (const pattern of categories.REAL_ERROR?.patterns || []) {\\n    const regex = new RegExp(pattern, 'i');\\n    if (regex.test(thinkingContent)) {\\n      return {\\n        category: categories.REASONING_FAIL?.patterns || []) {\\n    const regex = new RegExp(pattern, 'i');\\n    if (regex.test(thinkingContent)) {\\n      return {\\n        category: 'REASONING_FAIL',\\n        action: 'classify_and_record',\\n        record: true,\\n        reason: '推理失敗'\\n      };\\n    }\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 未知類型，記錄但不抑制\\n  return {\\n    category: 'UNKNOWN',\\n    action: handlerState.thinkingErrorCount++;\\n  \\n  const thinkingContent = thinkingData.content || thinkingData.thinking || '';\\n  \\n  // 分類（不抑制）\\n  const classification = classifyThinkingError(thinkingContent);\\n  \\n  log(`思考錯誤類別：${classification.category}`);\\n  log(`處置措施：${classification.action}`);\\n  log(`是否記錄：${classification.record}`);\\n  \\n  // 零隱瞞記錄\\n  if (classification.record) {\\n    zeroHiddenRecord({\\n      type: 'THINKING_ERROR',\\n      subtype: classification.category,\\n      data: {\\n        content: thinkingContent,\\n        reason: 複製文件\\n    fs.copyFileSync(configPath, backupPath);\\n    handlerState.backupCount++;\\n    \\n    log(`✅ 備份成功：${configPath} → ${backupPath}`);\\n    \\n    // 記錄備份日誌\\n    const backupLog = {\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n      original: configPath,\\n      backup: backupPath,\\n      backupCount: handlerState.backupCount\\n    };\\n = '/home/admin/.openclaw/config/knowledge-path-whitelist.json';\\nconst VALIDATION_RESULT_PATH = path.join(WORKSPACE, '.evolver/memory/knowledge-path-validation-result.json');\\n\\n// 載入配置\\nconst config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(CONFIG_PATH, 'utf8'));\\n\\n// 校驗結果\\nconst validationResult = {\\n  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n  path_to_check: null,\\n  is_valid: false,\\n  whitelist_match: null,\\n  suggested_path: null,\\n  violations: []\\n};\\n\\n/**\\n * 檢查路徑是否在白名單內\\n */\\nfunction checkPathWhitelist(targetPath) {\\n  console.log('=== 知識庫路徑白名單校驗 ===\\\\n');\\n  console.log(`目標路徑：${targetPath}`);\\n  \\n  validationResult.path_to_check = targetPath;\\n  \\n  // 正規化路徑\\n  const normalizedPath = path.resolve(targetPath);\\n  const relativePath = path.relative(WORKSPACE, normalizedPath);\\n  \\n  console.log(`正規化路徑：${normalizedPath}`);\\n  console.log(`相對路徑：${relativePath}\\\\n`);\\n  \\n  // 檢查白名單\\n  let whitelistMatch = null;\\n  for (const entry of config.path_whitelist) {\\n    if (entry.allowed && normalizedPath.startsWith(entry.path)) {\\n      whitelistMatch = entry;\\n      break;\\n    }\\n  }\\n  \\n  if (whitelistMatch) {\\n    console.log(`✅ 路徑在白名單內`);\\n    console.log(`   匹配項目：${whitelistMatch.purpose}`);\\n    console.log(`   允許路徑：${whitelistMatch.path}`);\\n    \\n    validationResult.is_valid = true;\\n    validationResult.whitelist_match = whitelistMatch;\\n    \\n    return { valid: true, match: whitelistMatch };\\n  }\\n  \\n  // 不在白名單內，檢查是否有映射\\n  console.log(`❌ 路徑不在白名單內`);\\n  \\n  let suggestedPath = null;\\n  for (const [wrongPath, correctPath] of Object.entries(config.path_mapping)) {\\n    if (relativePath.startsWith(wrongPath)) {\\n      suggestedPath = path.join(WORKSPACE, correctPath, relativePath.substring(wrongPath.length));\\n      console.log(`\\\\n⚠️ 發現錯誤路徑映射`);\\n      console.log(`   錯誤路徑：${relativePath}`);\\n      console.log(`   正確路徑：${correctPath}`);\\n      console.log(`   建議路徑：${suggestedPath}`);\\n      \\n      validationResult.suggested_path = suggestedPath;\\n      break;\\n    }\\n  }\\n  \\n  if (!suggestedPath) {\\n    console.log(`\\\\n🚫 無映射路徑，建議使用權威知識庫：${config.authoritative_path.knowledge_base}`);\\n    validationResult.suggested_path = config.authoritative_path.knowledge_base;\\n  }\\n  \\n  validationResult.is_valid = false;\\n  validationResult.violations.push({\\n    type: 'path_not_in_whitelist',\\n    target_path: targetPath,\\n    normalized_path: normalizedPath,\\n    relative_path: relativePath,\\n    suggested_path: validationResult.suggested_path\\n  });\\n  \\n  return { valid: false, suggested: validationResult.suggested_path };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 自動遷移錯誤路徑的文件\\n */\\nfunction autoMigrateFile(fromPath, toPath) {\\n  console.log(`\\\\n=== 自動遷移文件 ===`);\\n  console.log(`從：${fromPath}`);\\n  console.log(`到：${toPath}`);\\n  \\n  try {\\n    // 確保目標目錄存在\\n    const toDir = path.dirname(toPath);\\n    if (!fs.existsSync(toDir)) {\\n      fs.mkdirSync(toDir, { recursive: true });\\n      console.log(`✅ 創建目錄：${toDir}`);\\n    }\\n    \\n    // 複製文件\\n    fs.copyFileSync(fromPath, toPath);\\n    console.log(`✅ 複製文件成功`);\\n    \\n    // 刪除原文件\\n    fs.unlinkSync(fromPath);\\n    console.log(`✅ 刪除原文件`);\\n    \\n    // 記錄遷移日誌\\n    const migrationLog = path.join(WORKSPACE, '.evolver/memory/knowledge-migration-log.jsonl');\\n    const logEntry = {\\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n      from: fromPath,\\n      to: toPath,\\n      reason: 'constitutional_path_violation',\\n      auto_migrated: true\\n    };\\n    fs.appendFileSync(migrationLog, JSON.stringify(logEntry) + '\\\\n');\\n    console.log(`✅ 記錄遷移日誌`);\\n    \\n    return { success: true, migrated: true };\\n    \\n  } catch (error) {\\n    console.log(`❌ 遷移失敗：${error.message}`);\\n    return { success: false, error: error.message };\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 檢查並遷移 llm-wiki 下的文件到 AgentTeamllm-wiki\\n */\\nfunction migrateLegacyFiles() {\\n  console.log(`\\\\n=== 遷移歷史文件 (llm-wiki → AgentTeamllm-wiki) ===`);\\n  \\n  const legacyBase = path.join(WORKSPACE, 'llm-wiki');\\n  const targetBase = path.join(WORKSPACE, 'AgentTeamllm-wiki');\\n  \\n  if (!fs.existsSync(legacyBase)) {\\n    console.log('⚠️ llm-wiki 目錄不存在，跳過遷移');\\n    return { migrated: 0 };\\n  }\\n  \\n  const directories = ['assets', 'accidents', 'rules', 'reports', 'analysis', 'audit'];\\n  let migratedCount = 0;\\n  \\n  for (const dir of directories) {\\n    const legacyDir = path.join(legacyBase, dir);\\n    const targetDir = path.join(targetBase, dir);\\n    \\n    if (fs.existsSync(legacyDir)) {\\n      const files = fs.readdirSync(legacyDir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.md'));\\n      \\n      if (files.length > 0) {\\n        console.log(`\\\\n遷移 ${dir}/: ${files.length} 個文件`);\\n        \\n        // 確保目標目錄存在\\n        if (!fs.existsSync(targetDir)) {\\n          fs.mkdirSync(targetDir, { recursive: true });\\n        }\\n        \\n        for (const file of files) {\\n          const fromPath = path.join(legacyDir, file);\\n          const toPath = path.join(targetDir, file);\\n          \\n          // 檢查目標文件是否已存在\\n          if (fs.existsSync(toPath)) {\\n            console.log(`  ⚠️ 跳過 (已存在): ${file}`);\\n            continue;\\n          }\\n          \\n          // 遷移文件\\n          fs.copyFileSync(fromPath, toPath);\\n          fs.unlinkSync(fromPath);\\n          console.log(`  ✅ 遷移：${file}`);\\n          migratedCount++;\\n        }\\n      }\\n    }\\n  }\\n  \\n  console.log(`\\\\n遷移完成：${migratedCount} 個文件`);\\n  \\n  // 記錄遷移統計\\n  const statsPath = path.join(WORKSPACE, '.evolver/memory/knowledge-migration-stats.json');\\n  fs.writeFileSync(statsPath, JSON.stringify({\\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\\n    migrated_count: migratedCount,\\n    directories: directories,\\n    from: legacyBase,\\n    to: targetBase\\n  }, null, 2));\\n  \\n  return { migrated: migratedCount };\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * 輸出結果\\n */\\nfunction outputResult() {\\n 后台启动，不阻塞\\n        subprocess.Popen([\\\"python3\\\", PROXY_MANAGER, \\\"monitor\\\"], \\n                        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, \\n                        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,\\n                        start_new_session=True)\\n        log(\\\"✅ 代理监控已启动（后台）\\\")\\n        return True\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        log(f\\\"❌ 启动代理监控失败：{str(e)}\\\")\\n        return False\\n\\n\\ndef heartbeat(node_id, node_secret):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"调用 EvoMap heartbeat API (带重试机制)\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    # Adapt or die.\\\"**\\n\\nThe **Evolver** is a meta-skill that allows OpenClaw agents to inspect their own runtime history, identify failures or inefficiencies, and autonomously write new code or update their own memory to improve performance.\\n\\n## Features\\n\\n- **Auto-Log Analysis**: Automatically scans memory and history files for errors and patterns.\\n- **Self-Repair**: Detects crashes and suggests patches.\\n- GEP Protocol: Standardized evolution with reusable assets.\\n- **One-Command Evolution**: Just run `/evolve` (or `node index.js`).\\n\\n## Usage\\n\\n### Standard Run (Automated)\\nRuns the evolution cycle. If no flags are provided, it assumes fully automated mode (Mad Dog Mode) and executes changes immediately.\\n```bash\\nnode index.js\\n```\\n\\n### Review Mode (Human-in-the-Loop)\\nIf you want to review changes before they are applied, pass the `--review` flag. The agent will pause and ask for confirmation.\\n```bash\\nnode index.js --review\\n```\\n\\n### Mad Dog Mode (Continuous Loop)\\nTo run in an infinite loop (e.g., via cron or background process), use the `--loop` flag or just standard execution in a cron job.\\n```bash\\nnode index.js --loop\\n```\\n\\n## Setup\\n\\nBefore using this skill, register your node identity with the EvoMap network:\\n\\n1. Run the hello flow (via `evomap.js` or the EvoMap onboarding) to receive a `node_id` and claim code\\n2. Visit `https://evomap.ai/claim/<claim-code>` within 24 hours to bind the node to your account\\n3. Set the node identity in your environment:\\n\\n```bash\\nexport A2A_NODE_ID=node_xxxxxxxxxxxx\\n```\\n\\nOr in your agent config (e.g., `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json`):\\n\\n```json\\n{ \\\"env\\\": { \\\"A2A_NODE_ID\\\": \\\"node_xxxxxxxxxxxx\\\", \\\"A2A_HUB_URL\\\": \\\"https://evomap.ai\\\" } }\\n```\\n\\nDo not hardcode the node ID in scripts. `getNodeId()` in `src/gep/a2aProtocol.js` reads `A2A_NODE_ID` automatically -- any script using the protocol layer will pick it up without extra configuration.\\n\\n## Configuration\\n\\n### Required Environment Variables\\n\\n| Variable | Default | Description |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| `A2A_NODE_ID` | (required) | Your EvoMap node identity. Set after node registration -- never hardcode in scripts. |\\n\\n### Optional Environment Variables\\n\\n| Variable | Default | Description |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| `A2A_HUB_URL` | `https://evomap.ai` | EvoMap Hub API base URL. |\\n| `A2A_NODE_SECRET` | (none) | Node authentication secret issued by Hub on first hello. Stored locally after registration. |\\n| `EVOLVE_STRATEGY` | `balanced` | Evolution strategy: `balanced`, `innovate`, `harden`, `repair-only`, `early-stabilize`, `steady-state`, or `auto`. |\\n| `EVOLVE_ALLOW_SELF_MODIFY` | `false` | Allow evolution to modify evolver's own source code. **NOT recommended for production.** |\\n| `EVOLVE_LOAD_MAX` | `2.0` | Maximum 1-minute load average before evolver backs off. |\\n| `EVOLVER_ROLLBACK_MODE` | `hard` | Rollback strategy on failure: `hard` (git reset --hard), `stash` (git stash), `none` (skip). Use `stash` for safer operation. |\\n| `EVOLVER_LLM_REVIEW` | `0` | Set to `1` to enable second-opinion LLM review before solidification. |\\n| `EVOLVER_AUTO_ISSUE` | `0` | Set to `1` to auto-create GitHub issues on repeated failures. Requires `GITHUB_TOKEN`. |\\n| `EVOLVER_ISSUE_REPO` | (none) | GitHub repo for auto-issue reporting (e.g. `EvoMap/evolver`). |\\n| `EVOLVER_MODEL_NAME` | (none) | LLM model name injected into published asset `model_name` field. |\\n| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | (none) | GitHub API token for release creation and auto-issue reporting. Also accepts `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_PAT`. |\\n| `MEMORY_GRAPH_REMOTE_URL` | (none) | Remote knowledge graph service URL for memory sync. |\\n| `MEMORY_GRAPH_REMOTE_KEY` | (none) | API key for remote knowledge graph service. |\\n| `EVOLVE_REPORT_TOOL` | (auto) | Override report tool (e.g. `feishu-card`). |\\n| `RANDOM_DRIFT` | `0` | Enable random drift in evolution strategy selection. |\\n\\n### Network Endpoints\\n\\nEvolver communicates with these external services. All are authenticated and documented.\\n\\n| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose | Required |\\n|---|---|---|---|\\n| `{A2A_HUB_URL}/a2a/*` | `A2A_NODE_SECRET` (Bearer) | A2A protocol: hello, heartbeat, publish, fetch, reviews, tasks | Yes |\\n| `api.github.com/repos/*/releases` | `GITHUB_TOKEN` (Bearer) | Create releases, publish changelogs | No |\\n| `api.github.com/repos/*/issues` | `GITHUB_TOKEN` (Bearer) | Auto-create failure reports (sanitized via `redactString()`) | No |\\n| `{MEMORY_GRAPH_REMOTE_URL}/*` | `MEMORY_GRAPH_REMOTE_KEY` | Remote knowledge graph sync | No |\\n\\n### Shell Commands Used\\n\\nEvolver uses `child_process` for the following commands. No user-controlled input is passed to shell.\\n\\n| Command | Purpose |\\n|---|---|\\n| `git checkout`, `git clean`, `git log`, `git status`, `git diff` | Version control for evolution cycles |\\n| `git rebase --abort`, `git merge --abort` | Abort stuck git operations (self-repair) |\\n| `git reset --hard` | Rollback failed evolution (only when `EVOLVER_ROLLBACK_MODE=hard`) |\\n| `git stash` | Preserve failed evolution changes (when `EVOLVER_ROLLBACK_MODE=stash`) |\\n| `ps`, `pgrep`, `tasklist` | Process discovery for lifecycle management |\\n| `df -P` | Disk usage check (health monitoring fallback) |\\n| `npm install --production` | Repair missing skill dependencies |\\n| `node -e \\\"...\\\"` | Inline script execution for LLM review (no shell, uses `execFileSync`) |\\n\\n### File Access\\n\\n| Direction | Paths | Purpose |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| Read | `~/.evomap/node_id` | Node identity persistence |\\n| Read | `assets/gep/*` | GEP gene/capsule/event data |\\n| Read | `memory/*` | Evolution memory, narrative, reflection logs |\\n| Read | `package.json` | Version information |\\n| Write | `assets/gep/*` | Updated genes, capsules, evolution events |\\n| Write | `memory/*` | Memory graph, narrative log, reflection log |\\n| Write | `src/**` | Evolved code (only during solidify, with git tracking) |\\n\\n## GEP Protocol (Auditable Evolution)\\n\\nThis package embeds a protocol-constrained evolution prompt (GEP) and a local, structured asset store:\\n\\n- `assets/gep/genes.json`: reusable Gene definitions\\n- `assets/gep/capsules.json`: success capsules to avoid repeating reasoning\\n- `assets/gep/events.jsonl`: append-only evolution events (tree-like via parent id)\\n \\n## Emoji Policy\\n\\nOnly the DNA emoji is allowed in documentation. 秒\\n\\n\\ndef log(message):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"记录日志\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')\\n    log_msg = f\\\"[{timestamp}] {message}\\\"\\n    print(log_msg)\\n    \\n    LOG_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\\n    with open(LOG_FILE, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:\\n        f.write(log_msg + '\\\\n')\\n\\n\\ndef run_proxy_manager():\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"启动代理管理器（后台运行）\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    try:\\n        # 后台启动，不阻塞\\n        subprocess.Popen([\\\"python3\\\", PROXY_MANAGER, \\\"monitor\\\"], \\n                        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, \\n                        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,\\n                        start_new_session=True)\\n        log(\\\"✅ 代理监控已启动（后台）\\\")\\n        return True\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        log(f\\\"❌ 启动代理监控失败：{str(e)}\\\")\\n        return False\\n\\n\\ndef heartbeat(node_id, node_secret):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"调用 EvoMap heartbeat API (带重试机制)\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    # 秒\\n\\n\\ndef log(message):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"记录日志\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')\\n    log_msg = f\\\"[{timestamp}] {message}\\\"\\n    print(log_msg)\\n    \\n    LOG_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\\n    with open(LOG_FILE, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:\\n        f.write(log_msg + '\\\\n')\\n\\n\\ndef run_proxy_manager():\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"启动代理管理器（后台运行）\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    try:\\n        # 后台启动，不阻塞\\n        subprocess.Popen([\\\"python3\\\", PROXY_MANAGER, \\\"monitor\\\"], \\n                        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, \\n                        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,\\n                        start_new_session=True)\\n        log(\\\"✅ 代理监控已启动（后台）\\\")\\n        return True\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        log(f\\\"❌ 启动代理监控失败：{str(e)}\\\")\\n        return False\\n\\n\\ndef heartbeat(node_id, node_secret):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"调用 EvoMap heartbeat API (带重试机制)\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    # 使用正确的端点和格式\\n    url = f'{BASE_URL}/a2a/heartbeat'\\n    headers = {\\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\\n        'Authorization': f'Bearer {node_secret}'\\n    }\\n    payload = {\\n        'node_id': node_id\\n    }\\n    \\n    for attempt in range(MAX_RETRIES):\\n        try:\\n            resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=15)\\n            \\n            if resp.status_code == 200:\\n                result = resp.json()\\n                credits = result.get('credit_balance', 'N/A')\\n                capability = result.get('capability_profile', {})\\n                level = capability.get('level', 'N/A') if capability else 'N/A'\\n                next_hb = result.get('next_heartbeat_ms', 0)\\n                next_hb_min = f\\\"{next_hb / 1000 / 60:.1f}\\\" if isinstance(next_hb, (int, float)) else str(next_hb)\\n                return True, f\\\"成功 (Credits: {credits}, Level: {level}, Next: {next_hb_min}min)\\\"\\n            \\n            # 解析错误响应\\n            try:\\n                error_data = resp.json()\\n                error_msg = error_data.get('error', resp.text)\\n                log(f\\\"  尝试 {attempt+1}/{MAX_RETRIES}: HTTP {resp.status_code} - {error_msg}\\\")\\n            except:\\n                log(f\\\"  尝试 {attempt+1}/{MAX_RETRIES}: HTTP {resp.status_code}\\\")\\n            \\n        except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:\\n            log(f\\\"  尝试 {attempt+1}/{MAX_RETRIES}: {str(e)}\\\")\\n        \\n        if attempt < MAX_RETRIES - 1:\\n            time.sleep(RETRY_DELAY)\\n    \\n    return False, \\\"所有重试均失败\\\"\\n\\n\\ndef main():\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"主函数\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    log(\\\"=\\\" * 60)\\n    log(\\\"EvoMap 节点心跳开始 (增强版)\\\")\\n    \\n    # 确保代理监控运行\\n    run_proxy_manager()\\n    \\n    success_count = 0\\n    fail_count = 0\\n    \\n    for i, node in enumerate(NODES):\\n        log(f\\\"\\\\n{node['name']}: {node['id']}\\\")\\n        success, msg = heartbeat(node['id'], node['secret'])\\n        \\n        if success:\\n            log(f\\\"  ✅ {msg}\\\")\\n            success_count += 1\\n        else:\\n            log(f\\\"  ❌ {msg}\\\")\\n            fail_count += 1\\n        \\n        if i < len(NODES) - 1:\\n            log(\\\"  ⏳ 等待 20 秒以避免速率限制...\\\")\\n            time.sleep(20)\\n    \\n    log(f\\\"\\\\n总计：成功 {success_count}/{len(NODES)}, 失败 {fail_count}/{len(NODES)}\\\")\\n    log(\\\"=\\\" * 60)\\n    \\n    return fail_count == 0\\n\\n\\nif __name__ == '__main__':\\n    main()\\n\"}],\"isError\":false,\"timestamp\":1776324615290}}"
}

秒\\n\\n\\ndef log(message):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"记录日志\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')\\n    log_msg = f\\\"[{timestamp}] {message}\\\"\\n    print(log_msg)\\n    \\n    LOG_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\\n    with open(LOG_FILE, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:\\n        f.write(log_msg + '\\\\n')\\n\\n\\ndef run_proxy_manager():\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"启动代理管理器（后台运行）\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    try:\\n        # 后台启动，不阻塞\\n        subprocess.Popen([\\\"python3\\\", PROXY_MANAGER, \\\"monitor\\\"], \\n                        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, \\n                        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,\\n                        start_new_session=True)\\n        log(\\\"✅ 代理监控已启动（后台）\\\")\\n        return True\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        log(f\\\"❌ 启动代理监控失败：{str(e)}\\\")\\n        return False\\n\\n\\ndef heartbeat(node_id, node_secret):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"调用 EvoMap heartbeat API (带重试机制)\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    #
